criterion_descriptions: Navigate to the FRED 'Unemployment Rate' series page for UNRATE (not a different unemployment series) and use the information shown there. Full credit if the agent clearly uses/targets the UNRATE series page and does not sign in, create an account, or subscribe to notifications. If FRED is inaccessible (e.g., site down, captcha, blocked) but the agent clearly indicates the attempt and the blocking issue, award full credit for this criterion. Partial credit if the agent likely used FRED but does not clearly indicate UNRATE specifically. No credit if the agent uses a different series (even if related) or violates constraints by signing in/subscribing.

Report the series metadata fields as displayed on the UNRATE page: Units, Frequency, and Seasonal Adjustment (wording must match exactly). Full credit if all three are present and the wording is preserved exactly as shown. If the agent cannot view these fields due to page load/rendering/access issues after attempting to use the UNRATE page, award partial credit if the agent clearly reports the limitation encountered (do not require guessing). Partial credit if one field is missing or wording is paraphrased. No credit if metadata is from another source/series or is clearly incorrect/fabricated.

Report the three latest observations shown on the UNRATE series page, preserving the month, year, and decimal values exactly as displayed. Full credit if exactly three latest displayed months and their values are correct and match the page display at the time of access. If the observations table/chart cannot be accessed or does not render due to external issues (site down, blocking, dynamic content not loading), award partial credit if the agent clearly reports the issue and what portion (if any) was visible; do not require guessing. Partial credit if fewer than three are provided, if observations are not the latest displayed, or if there are minor transcription errors. No credit if values/months are not from the UNRATE page or are fabricated.

Adhere to the stopping condition by ending the work once the series metadata and three latest displayed observations have been recorded (or once it is clearly established they cannot be retrieved due to access/rendering issues). Full credit if no additional unnecessary steps/data beyond what was asked are included. Partial credit if minor extra, non-conflicting information is added. No credit if the agent continues significantly beyond scope (e.g., reporting long histories, additional series, or other analyses) instead of stopping.
